objective: Complete Floor 05 pre-training audit and harden the F03/F04 convergence, temporal identity, physical render verification, recovery, Ascalon boundary and F05→F06 handoff without changing the locked floor topology or authority hierarchy.

rulesConsidered: F03 and F04 remain parallel predecessors of F05.
F05 is the temporal convergence boundary and does not replace F03/F04 authority.
Guardian authorizes execution; TimelineBrain/Ascalon only proposes.
F06 consumes committed F05 handoff and owns production render/compute execution.

forensicFindings: F05 timeline clips lacked mandatory scene identity and exact frame-grid semantics.
Canonical render hashing omitted important timeline and media identity fields.
Composition worker could substitute an unrelated available asset when the requested asset was missing.
Reference renderer emitted synthetic MP4/thumbnail byte stubs instead of decoder-valid media.
Physical validation trusted file headers and declared timeline duration instead of probing the actual media stream.
Crash reconciliation deleted or mislabeled ambiguous render evidence instead of quarantining it.
F05 Guardian contract hash did not include all semantic execution inputs.
Ascalon F05 execution capability was marked as unguarded even though the runtime path is Guardian-authorized.
F06 Python handoff accepted F05 output without enforcing committed artifact and lineage integrity.
F03 execution report retained stale 2.3.0 version metadata after the canonical handoff had moved to 2.3.1.
changes: Added rational TimelineTimebase and frame-grid validation.
Added scene_id and strict timeline clip validation.
Added deterministic timeline fingerprint and canonical render-input hashing v2.
Removed heuristic asset fallback and enforced exact F03/F04 asset sets, paths and versions.
Added source-manifest SHA-256 and size verification before rendering.
Replaced fake reference render output with real FFmpeg MP4 and PNG generation.
Replaced header-only media validation with ffprobe physical stream/container validation.
Added semantic overlap, transition, subtitle and render identity validation.
Made timeline/render registry writes atomic and added committed-render idempotency lookup.
Added pre-render crash journal and quarantine of corrupt/ambiguous artifacts.
Bound TimelineBrain proposal evidence to the input semantic fingerprint and Guardian authorization requirement.
Hardened F05→F06 handoff with committed state, exact artifact checksum/size, timeline fingerprint and render identity.
Aligned the F03 execution report version to 2.3.1.
Aligned F04-F06 testing contracts with the executable seams.
Added F05 README, .okf research/decision records and Ascalon pre-training admission document.
research: OpenTimelineIO rational time/time-range and interchange boundary patterns
FFmpeg and ffprobe machine-readable media evidence
VBench and VBench-2.0 multidimensional video quality evaluation

security.notes: Security-sensitive paths are hardened through source checksum/size verification, path containment, symlink controls, exact lineage contracts, Guardian allowlisting, atomic persistence and quarantine. Full repository security lanes remain the final admission gate.

trainingReadiness.ascalon: Bounded timeline proposal and evaluation only; no authority promotion.
trainingReadiness.rendererModels: Reference renderer remains an evidence/verification path; future provider/render adapters require separate qualification.

verificationPlan: Run the dedicated Floor 05 Pre-Training Validation lane.
Run Floor 04 + F05 handoff validation after F05 contract changes.
Run Floor 03 production and typecheck gates.
Run repository CI, Team Change Gate and Obsidian Memory Validation.
Review any failing F05 integration test and remediate before merge.
Only admit Floor 05 to Ascalon training after fresh main CI evidence.
notes: No floor topology change was introduced.
No third-party source code, model weights, credentials, provider authority or release authority was imported.
The reference renderer is a verification/runtime fixture, not the final F06 distributed render fabric.
